evals.prompt: /user-flow E-commerce checkout: user browses products, adds to cart, logs in or continues as guest, enters shipping address, selects payment method, places order, receives confirmation
evals.expected_output: Generates a flowchart with at least 5 nodes including a login/guest decision diamond and a payment success/failure decision. Generates a journey diagram with at least 3 sections. Provides Key Insights and Potential Improvements sections. Uses 'flowchart TD' syntax (not 'graph TD'). Proposes diagram types before generating (or generates all if --type all given).

assertions.name: flowchart-present
assertions.text: A mermaid flowchart code block is present in the response

assertions.name: flowchart-syntax-valid
assertions.text: The flowchart uses 'flowchart TD' or 'flowchart LR', not the deprecated 'graph TD'

assertions.name: journey-present
assertions.text: A mermaid journey code block is present in the response

assertions.name: decision-nodes
assertions.text: The flowchart contains at least 2 decision diamonds (e.g. login/guest choice, payment success/failure)

assertions.name: error-path
assertions.text: The flowchart shows at least one error or failure path (payment failure, invalid address, etc.)

assertions.name: insights-section
assertions.text: A 'Key Insights' section is present with at least 2 bullet points

assertions.name: improvements-section
assertions.text: A 'Potential Improvements' section is present with at least 1 concrete suggestion

evals.prompt: /user-flow --type flowchart,state SAP Fiori Elements List Report app: user opens app, sets filters for company code and date range, clicks Go, selects a row in the results table, navigates to the Object Page, switches to edit mode, modifies a field, saves the record
evals.expected_output: Generates a flowchart showing the full List Report to Object Page navigation flow. Generates a state diagram showing display/edit/saving/saved states. Flowchart includes filter bar, table results, row selection, Object Page display, edit mode, and save steps. State diagram uses 'stateDiagram-v2'. No proposal pause because --type flag was provided.

assertions.name: flowchart-fiori
assertions.text: Flowchart includes both 'List Report' and 'Object Page' as distinct nodes or labels

assertions.name: edit-states
assertions.text: The state diagram includes at least 3 states representing the edit flow (e.g. Display, Edit, Saving or similar)

assertions.name: filter-step
assertions.text: The flowchart includes a filter or search step before results are shown

assertions.name: no-mcp-calls
assertions.text: The response contains only Mermaid code blocks — no references to SVG files, Live Editor URLs, or MCP tool calls

evals.prompt: /user-flow --type sequence Authentication flow: user submits email and password on the login form, the frontend sends credentials to the API, the API validates against the database, returns a JWT on success or 401 on failure, the client stores the token in localStorage and redirects to the dashboard
evals.expected_output: Generates a sequence diagram with at least 3 actors (User/Frontend, API, Database). Includes an alt/else block for the 401 failure path. Shows the JWT storage step. Uses correct sequenceDiagram syntax with participant declarations. No proposal pause because --type flag was provided.

assertions.name: sequence-diagram-present
assertions.text: A mermaid sequenceDiagram code block is present

assertions.name: three-actors
assertions.text: The sequence diagram declares at least 3 participants/actors (e.g. User or Frontend, API, Database)

assertions.name: error-alt-block
assertions.text: The sequence diagram contains an 'alt' or 'else' block covering the 401 or authentication failure case

assertions.name: jwt-or-token
assertions.text: The sequence diagram shows JWT issuance or token storage as a step

assertions.name: insights-present
assertions.text: Key Insights section is present with at least one insight about the auth flow
